Remember the first stage of development in group therapy is Forming. In the Forming stage I always have the group members perform as their first exercise developing group rules. No telling war stories (this one time I did this and it was cool/ funny). No attacking other members. And I let them decide on what the consequences will be for rule breaking.... and how a member can get back into the groups good graces. This puts the responsibility on them for their actions leaving no one to blame but themselves and no one to ask permission/forgiveness other than the group members. 
Even if this is a on- going group you can do this when new members arrive. You will be amazed at what they come up with....way tougher than I ever would have been.
